name: Dino 246 GT
description: The Dino 246 GT (1969–1974) was Ferrari's first mid-engine road car sold under the Dino sub-brand (Enzo refused to put the Ferrari name on a V6). Its compact 2.4-litre V6, curvaceous Pininfarina styling, and featherweight chassis established the mid-engine sports car formula that Ferrari would refine through the 308, 348, and beyond.
